hits.text: Common Prefix | Senior Software Engineer | Athens, Greece / REMOTE | Full-time | $80k to $160k + equity + bonus We're hiring Senior Software Engineers! We're a mix of scientists (professors, PhDs, and postdocs from Stanford, Imperial, ETH Zürich, and Edinburgh) and engineers with decades in hedge funds, TradFi, and Web3. We lead Axelar, the network that moves assets and messages between blockchains, and work with teams like Ripple, Mysten Labs, Flashbots, and Celestia. We’re looking for engineers with 5+ years of experience and a strong track record of shipping software to production. You’ve owned core parts of what you built, not just the edges, and you like working from first principles. No blockchain experience needed. We mostly use Rust, Go, and TypeScript. You can work remotely or from our office in Athens. On top of that, you get unlimited time off, a budget for your laptop and home office, a yearly offsite somewhere cool, and 2 to 3 conferences a year. Most of what we build is open source: https://github.com/commonprefix Role: https://commonprefix.notion.site/seniorswe-folk Apply (no recruiters): https://commonprefix.notion.site/2b7bf672de828051b53cdd37811...
